name: talkledger-server
description: Backend API server for TalkLedger with SQLite, Prisma, and AI voice parsing

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-db-provider.mjs && npx prisma generate && npx tsc
scripts.db:switch:sqlite: node scripts/switch-db.mjs sqlite && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:switch:postgres: node scripts/switch-db.mjs postgres && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:migrate:postgres: node scripts/switch-db.mjs postgres && npx prisma generate && npx tsx scripts/migrate-sqlite-to-postgres.ts
